# NetDiag Twin 0.5.3

This release strengthens connector correctness, resource bounds, credential isolation, and release integrity.

- Fails closed on malformed, incomplete, ambiguous, or oversized telemetry inputs.
- Rejects duplicate JSON keys recursively at adapter, trace, dataset, journal,
  feedback, and secret-inspection boundaries instead of allowing last-value
  overwrite semantics.
- Requires bundled adapters to emit the versioned `netdiag-adapter-payload/v2`
  contract with complete, typed provenance for every canonical numeric metric;
  legacy v1 payloads remain readable, but undeclared metrics are treated as
  missing rather than measured.
- Adds deterministic OTLP and Prometheus validation with bounded resource use.
- Keeps DNS, timeout, network, certificate, and TLS protocol failures distinct
  so non-TLS failures cannot produce a TLS-handshake diagnosis.
- Isolates bearer credentials by source identity and canonical network origin.
- Hardens settings recovery, atomic artifact publication, updater validation, and native capture paths.
- Runs performance measurements inside an owned, root-bound staged scope and
  never recursively clears a caller-selected artifact path.
- Adds `netdiag artifact-root initialize --artifacts <path>` for new empty roots and `artifact-root migrate` for explicit, validated adoption of pre-v0.5.3 roots; ambiguous or unrelated non-empty directories remain unclaimed.
- Migrates an exact v0.5.2 flat model only through a locked explicit model write: the old bytes are retained in a hash-bound generation and remain untouched until the v2 pointer commits.
- Keeps the bundled tc/netem adapter read-only until active qdisc changes have verified, crash-safe rollback.
- Requires live capture interfaces to use the explicit `iface:` prefix; bare values are treated as file paths so a missing capture file cannot silently become a device open.
- Expands cross-platform, security, architecture, and release-gate coverage.
- On Windows, operations that publish run directories or clear run history fail before mutation because v0.5.3 does not yet provide the required crash-durable, no-clobber directory primitive there.
